command: set -euo pipefail; snapshot_count(){ D="$1"; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database > "$D/tracker_database"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-wal > "$D/tracker_database-wal" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$D/tracker_database-wal"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-shm > "$D/tracker_database-shm" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$D/tracker_database-shm"; sqlite3 "$D/tracker_database" 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signal_samples;'; }; BEFORE=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-fixed-off-before | tail -n1); PID_BEFORE=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID_BEFORE"; adb shell input keyevent 26; sleep 5; echo '--- POWER_OFF_STATE ---'; POWER1=$(adb shell dumpsys power | grep -E 'mWakefulness=|Display Power: state=' | head -n 10 || true); echo "$POWER1"; echo "$POWER1" | grep -Eq 'mWakefulness=(Asleep|Dozing)|Display Power: state=OFF'; sleep 90; POWER2=$(adb shell dumpsys power | grep -E 'mWakefulness=|Display Power: state=' | head -n 10 || true); echo '--- POWER_AFTER_90S ---'; echo "$POWER2"; echo "$POWER2" | grep -Eq 'mWakefulness=(Asleep|Dozing)|Display Power: state=OFF'; PID_OFF=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test "$PID_OFF" = "$PID_BEFORE"; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'isForeground=true'; AFTER=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-fixed-off-after | tail -n1); echo SCREEN_OFF_COUNTS=$BEFORE,$AFTER; test "$AFTER" -gt "$BEFORE" || { echo SCREEN_OFF_SAMPLE_GROWTH_FAIL >&2; adb logcat -d -v brief -s BleScanner:V ScannerService:V BleScanSource:V '*:S' | tail -n 160; exit 41; }; echo SCREEN_OFF_SAMPLE_GROWTH_PASS; adb shell input keyevent 26; sleep 4; adb shell wm dismiss-keyguard >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; PID_WAKE=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test "$PID_WAKE" = "$PID_BEFORE"; echo '--- BLE_MODE_LOGS ---'; LOGS=$(adb logcat -d -v brief -s BleScanner:V ScannerService:V BleScanSource:V '*:S'); echo "$LOGS" | tail -n 180; echo "$LOGS" | grep -q 'BACKGROUND_FILTERED'; echo "$LOGS" | grep -q 'Switching passive BLE scan from BROAD to BACKGROUND_FILTERED'; echo "$LOGS" | grep -q 'Switching passive BLE scan from BACKGROUND_FILTERED to BROAD'; echo '--- APP_FATALS ---'; adb logcat -d -v brief --pid="$PID_WAKE" | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime|SecurityException|IllegalStateException|SQLiteException|OutOfMemoryError' && exit 42 || true; echo SCREEN_STATE_MODE_TRANSITIONS_PASS; echo PHASE3_FIXED_SCREENOFF_ACCEPTANCE_PASS
